name: study-kit-codex
description: Study Kit Personal, a personal adaptation of Hyeonoh Hur's Study Kit. Build focused study materials and prepare for exams from verified course sources, with answer-writing practice and reusable preferences. Includes 15 Codex skills.

interface.shortDescription: Understand your course and practice writing exam answers.
interface.longDescription: A personal adaptation of Hyeonoh Hur's Study Kit. Verify sources, build focused study materials, and revise them from your questions. Exam preparation adds course scope, a three-point essay default, separate explanation and answer languages, and a record of the latest materials and next action. Includes 15 skills. DOCX and PDF output requires suitable host document tools; the kit supplies procedures and templates.
defaultPrompt: Help me start a course of study by asking about my background and goals.
Prepare my next study session from the curriculum and remaining questions.
Use exam-study to prepare from my lecture materials, practice writing answers, and keep track of the latest files.
Revise my textbook from the pending changes and prepare both PDF editions.
